mapper.select: SELECT t.top_job_code AS topJobCode, t.top_job_name AS topJobName, j.job_code AS jobCode, j.top_job_code AS jobTopJobCode, j.job_name AS jobName FROM top_job t LEFT JOIN job j ON t.top_job_code = j.top_job_code ORDER BY t.top_job_code, j.job_code
SELECT TOP_JOB_CODE , TOP_JOB_NAME FROM TOP_JOB WHERE TOP_JOB_CODE = #{topJobCode}
